# Wedeo browser media studio

Wedeo is a Rust and WebAssembly media studio. The browser interface opens local media files. Sample clips and downloadable packages are separate from user-selected files.

- [Browser studio](https://wedeo.sharifhsn.dev/)
- [Python package index](https://wedeo.sharifhsn.dev/simple/wedeo/)
- [Project source and documentation](https://github.com/sharifhsn/wedeo)
